mentions.name: Altitag
mentions.description: This app lets real estate photographers upload drone photos and overlay points-of-interest pins generated from EXIF data, adding neighborhood context annotations without needing Photoshop.
mentions.problem: Adding neighborhood context annotations to real estate drone photos would otherwise require opening Photoshop.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://altitag.com: A real estate photographer can upload a drone photo and get points of interest pins overlaid on the photo using EXIF data. The annotations help provide some nice neighborhood context without needing to open up Photoshop.
